nodes.label: Shared github.io origin isolation (namespaced id, scope, cache, storage keys)
nodes.norm_label: shared github.io origin isolation (namespaced id, scope, cache, storage keys)
nodes.rationale: The game shares user.github.io with other games, so manifest id is transport-king, SW scope is limited to the folder, cache is named transport-king-v<version>-<build>, and progress uses transport-king.* keys; cache cleanup never touches other apps.

nodes.label: Seeded endless level generation
nodes.rationale: Levels derive deterministically from level number so level N is always the same and there is no last level; several mazes are built and the one with longest blocking chains is kept to maximize difficulty.

nodes.label: Web Audio synthesized per-theme sounds
nodes.rationale: Sounds are synthesized live with the Web Audio API so there are no audio files and they work offline; boarding sounds climb a pentatonic scale; mute choice is remembered.

nodes.label: Winnability guarantee (line built from a real solution)
nodes.norm_label: winnability guarantee (line built from a real solution)
nodes.rationale: Every level is checked: all vehicles can exit, seats equal passengers, and the passenger line comes from a real solution fitting in the parking spots.
